design_philosophy: Institutional Trust and Verifiability. Clean, trustworthy, and reliant on strict data hierarchy. Uses organic greens to signify land and growth, balanced with trust blue for institutional reliability.

headings.usage: h1 to h6, section titles, card titles

body.usage: All standard text, paragraphs, labels, form inputs

monospace.usage: Parcel numbers, SHA-256 hashes, transaction IDs, code snippets, system logs, verification stamps

surfaces.verification_stamps: Use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tight tracking, nested inside a 1px dashed border with a subtle green tint.
surfaces.audit_timeline: Vertical left border #2e7d52/20, absolute positioned nodes using #2e7d52, timestamps in JetBrains Mono.

landing_login.left_panel: Green-blue gradient background (#e8f5e9 to #e0f7fa to #e3f2fd). Center LandVault logo, primary tagline. Includes animated trust stats (e.g. 'Over 1M+ Parcels Secured') floating via green-tinted glassmorphism panels.
landing_login.right_panel: Solid white (#ffffff) housing the auth card. Card uses 12px radius, inputs 8px, buttons 24px.

dashboards.description: Control Room Grid. Dense, data-oriented, compact spacing for tables and forms.
dashboards.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, white background, text_secondary for inactive, primary for active states.

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#2e7d52], text-white, rounded-[24px]. Secondary buttons: bg-white, text-[#1565c0], border border-[#1565c0].
components.inputs: rounded-[8px], border border-[#2e7d52]/15, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2e7d52]/50 focus:border-[#2e7d52].
components.trust_badges: SVG badges (lucide-react shield-check), colored #2e7d52. Text in JetBrains Mono.
components.kpi_cards: Glassmorphism surface. Large text in Plus Jakarta Sans. Subtle icon top right.

hero_landscape.description: Aerial view of city/buildings for the landing page or trust architecture background.

surveyor_dashboard.description: Surveyor tripod on land for the surveyor assignments module.

evidence_vault.description: Padlock indicating secure digital verification, used in the Evidence Vault explainer.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react for icons. Use Shield, CheckCircle, FileText, Map, Activity.
Use Javascript (.js/.jsx), do not use Typescript (.ts/.tsx).
Use Shadcn UI components but customize borders (8px/12px radius) and shadows (0 2px 12px rgba(46,125,82,0.08)) to match the institutional aesthetic.
Do NOT use generic Inter for headings, strictly use Plus Jakarta Sans weight 700.
Apply the background gradient strictly as 'linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9 0%, #e0f7fa 50%, #e3f2fd 100%)' to the main containers or body.
Create the 13-layer status dashboard in Admin Command Center using grid with amber/red/green indicators.
Wrap SHA-256 hashes in JetBrains Mono inside the Evidence Vault.
Ensure all text contrast passes accessibility checks, especially text_secondary (#546e7a) on light backgrounds.
Follow mobile-first responsive layout strategies for all portals and dashboards.
